name: Mose Ryder
role: Cowboy, Hashknife beef herd foreman and Medora deputy sheriff
bio: Mose ("Big Foot") Ryder was a Medora cowboy whom the paper in February 1884 called one of the best in Dakota. That winter he led a crew cutting fence posts up the river, reported to have cut 1,500 by March. In 1885 he won a shooting match for non-members of the gun club, rode Goodall's Splinter to victory in the Fourth of July race, and had charge of the Cannon Ball beef herd of Hashknife cattle; that October he was foreman of the line riders holding Hashknife cattle on Ash coulie creek. By August 1886 he was a deputy sheriff, arresting a man for firing a revolver in town and bringing in the body of a cowboy killed by lightning with Coroner Martin.
